newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 is now Steam Deck Verified!
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile 2 is finally Steam Deck Verified! Take the next generation of Action RPGs with you wherever you go, whether you’re battling through Wraeclast on the move or from the comfort of your couch. Jump in and experience Path of Exile 2 on Steam Deck today by purchasing the Early Access Key, or play as the Duelist when Path of Exile 2 becomes free to play on December 11 PST. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/102c4212f701156fb765058300afc9d95b294c5b.png

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 преодолела миллион регистраций до релиза 11 декабря
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile 2 преодолела отметку в миллион регистраций до полного релиза, который запланирован на 11 декабря. Вместе с этим достижением разработчики открыли очередную награду — эффект для оружия Soulflame Weapon Effect. Его получат все игроки, зарегистрировавшиеся для получения обновлений о полном релизе. Таким образом, каждый участник акции гарантированно заберёт как минимум два эксклюзивных косметических эффекта к моменту запуска игры. При этом разработчики не собираются останавливаться на достигнутом: до 11 декабря по тихоокеанскому времени остаётся возможность открыть ещё три награды, ес...

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 Full Release Registration - New Reward Unlocked
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: The Soulflame Weapon Effect, a new milestone reward for signing up for Path of Exile 2 Full Release updates, has been unlocked! This means that everyone who registered will receive at least two exclusive cosmetic effects when Path of Exile 2 fully launches on December 11th. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/e3e4d836320d46251dcc5410e75e6ac42aaa61e4.png You have until December 11 PST to register, so there’s still plenty of time to reach the remaining milestones! newsitems.title: Fan Art Competition Winners
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Our Fan Art Competition concluded last week, with more than 150 Exiles submitting artwork inspired by the latest Path of Exile and Path of Exile 2 content expansions. With the help of our art team, we’ve selected the winners and are now ready to announce them! Because of the enormous number of amazing submissions, it was really hard to select just three overall winners. So, we decided to award the top five winners in both games, as well as introduce a separate category for the top physical art submissions. Click here to check out the winners! newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 Full Release Registration
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Sign up at https://pathofexile2.com/register to receive updates on the Path of Exile 2 Full Release and get exclusive rewards! You have until December 10th to register, so there is still plenty of time to reach the milestones. The more players who register, the more cosmetics the community can unlock. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/b83d97b61de11f586aeb96da8868910194192cd6.jpg Please note that you need to confirm your registration after entering your email address. If you submitted your email address earlier, please check your inbox for a confirmation email from us!
